results.question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.

results.predicted_sql:

FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
GROUP BY s.School, s.DOCType
HAVING diff > (
    SELECT AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) - AVG(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS avg_diff
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

);
